expectations.text: The response restates the deck's job as verbs or an effect on its audience rather than as 'a deck'
expectations.evidence: Speaker notes state: “只提三个决策，每个都给出时间与不做的代价，方便 VP 当场拍板。” This defines the presentation’s intended effect on its audience.

expectations.text: The response suggests borrowing from other fields (a crew), including at least one adversarial or red-team role
expectations.evidence: The response lists “行动计划 5 项（负责人/时间/衡量指标）” and “需要 VP 拍板的 3 件事 + 风险提示,” but proposes no borrowed disciplinary crew or adversarial role.

expectations.text: The response describes what each field would do, not how it would write or sound
expectations.evidence: No borrowed fields or their contributions are described. “产品 / 客户成功” and “数据 / 客户成功” are owners of Q4 business actions, not fields recruited to develop the QBR.
